title: Decaying AI Threat Selection
description: Implement an AI threat system using damage, distance, healing, visibility, and time-based decay to choose a target.
requirements: Threat sources must use configurable weightings.
Destroyed or invalid targets must be removed safely.
Target changes must use hysteresis to avoid rapid switching.
The system must explain why the current target was selected.
constraint: Do not identify gameplay objects, states, or actions using display-name strings.
